draft.subject: Hardware intern role and your data collection work
draft.body:
I am Justin Mascarenhas. I have an M.S. in Computer Engineering from Rochester Institute of Technology. I am looking at the Hardware and Electronics Intern, Robotics role at NDimensions Labs. The posting says the hardware team works with the AI team on data collection, so I wanted to write to someone on the AI side.

My capstone sits right on that line. I built a vision guided robot arm around a Jetson and an Arduino, set up a data collection pipeline in the LeRobot format with multi camera capture, and ran a TensorRT optimized YOLO model for visual servoing. I also spent a lot of time on the unglamorous part, tracking down sensor and servo failures so the hardware behaved the same way every run. That is what a data collection setup needs from its hardware.

I would appreciate the opportunity to discuss the role further, if your time allows. I can share my resume if that would be helpful.
